name: Pilgrim VR: Hajj and Umrah (Lite)
summary:
Pilgrim VR Lite is an immersive virtual reality application designed to provide users with a detailed tour of the Hajj and Umrah pilgrimage landmarks in Makkah. This VR experience allows you to explore realistic recreations of holy sites and gain insight into their significance. It’s an ideal resource for students, educators, and anyone interested in discovering more about these significant religious practices.
